meaning: Checks stored UEDB5 file metadata row existence and accepted source-selected loader attribution across all three UE2 games, not original byte/asset payload or per-import native runtime verification
source_authority: UnrealDB accepted Epic game-source loader policies for Unreal II, UT2003 and UT2004, selected by game/version/licensee
production_query_mode: DEV -> PRD 192.168.0.55 MySQL read-only transaction; one group query; original package bytes unchanged

summary.profile_definition: source-selected loader policy, not original package producer

accepted_current_profiles: Unreal II v60-69/0 or127 and v126/0; UT2003 v120/28; UT2004 v127/29 under v127 or v128 loader, v128/29 under v128, v129/27 or29 under v129
limitations: UEDB5 metadata registration and source-policy rows are checked, not physical container byte hashes or individual persisted section-schema records
Unsupported/historical file versions remain deliberately without source-certified VerifyImport; a source loader policy stored in UEDB5 is not proof of producer identity
No native VerifyImport trace for every individual import
No original files staged/rescanned or database/storage rows modified
